The '''Comark Orchards''' were an orchard owned by the [[Comark family]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nayli]]. The orchards produced [[Jaquira fruit/Legends|jaquiria]] and [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
